column1: # Loads that cannot be read: an import() or a require() of something that is not one plain string
# (PlanSwap-4, the fix of its landing review). The fence fails every other such load, since what it
# loads cannot be checked. Each line names the file, the source of what it loads (its spaces
# collapsed) and why that is safe. Read by fence.ts; like the fence's list, it only shrinks.
